summary: Email Preview feature tested end-to-end (backend pytest + Playwright UI). All requested flows pass: Leads row-action preview, preview-send (expected Google-not-connected error toast), Lead details preview, Templates page preview of unsaved edits (invitation + visit_confirmation), no email log on preview, 401 without auth.

minor.issue: When lead_id is given, SAMPLE_VALS (PURPOSE, APPROVED_DATE, etc.) are still merged in, while send_invitation only replaces COMPANY_NAME/HR_NAME/JNF_URL. If an admin adds e.g. [PURPOSE] to the invitation template, the preview would show 'Campus Placement Drive' but the real email would contain literal '[PURPOSE]' - preview is not 'exactly' what is sent in that edge case.

Uses `body.get('subject') or tpl['subject']` - if admin clears the subject/body in the editor, preview silently shows the saved version instead of the empty draft. Low impact (save rejects empty anyway).

action_items: Optional: for lead previews, build vals exactly as send_invitation does (only COMPANY_NAME/HR_NAME/JNF_URL) or share a single helper so preview == sent email
Optional: use `body.get('subject') is not None` instead of `or` to preview empty drafts faithfully
critical_code_review_comments: Invitation vals dict is duplicated in send_invitation, jnf_reminder, test_invitation and preview_template - extract a helper to guarantee preview parity
server.py is ~1500 lines; should be split into routers
seed_data_creation: None. Template edits were made only in the editor (unsaved) and reverted; verified no TEST_EDIT persisted. One extra Failed invitation email log created by clicking preview-send-btn on lead row 0 (expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 covered email preview. Email log count unchanged after preview (16->16), incremented after send (16->17). Template list item testids: tpl-{key}; editor: tpl-subject, tpl-body, tpl-save-btn, tpl-preview-btn.
